name: Extended Teaching Dimension
definition: The **extended teaching dimension** is $$\mathrm{XTD}(\mathcal{H}) := \max_{f\subseteq\mathcal{X}}\min\left\{|S|:S\subseteq\mathcal{X},\;\left|\{h\in\mathcal{H}:h\cap S=f\cap S\}\right|\leq 1\right\}.$$ Thus the target labeling $f$ need not belong to $\mathcal{H}$.
description: Equivalently, it is the largest minimum size of a specifying set for an arbitrary labeling with respect to the class.
graph_summary: Maximum, over arbitrary target labelings, of the minimum number of coordinates needed to leave at most one consistent hypothesis.
